items.description: “Roth assets would provide our children with tax-free distributions.”

items.title: Nvidia’s stock is climbing as investors get more confidence in an expanding base of AI customers
items.description: Dell’s earnings showed that demand for AI hardware extends beyond major cloud providers.

items.title: ‘I currently give him $1,000 a month’: My grandson has severe mental illness. How do I protect him after I’m gone?
items.description: “I’m desperately trying to plan ahead while I’m still able.”

items.title: Palantir’s stock is slumping. Why bond yields and Google may be to blame.
items.description: After a strong postearnings rally in August, Palantir’s rich valuation multiple is under pressure once again.

items.title: How Oracle’s ‘extremely controversial’ stock could more than double from here
items.description: Oracle could be “nearing the end” of its need to raise cash, a Bernstein analyst says.

items.title: How GoPro went from viral camera sensation to a victim of smartphone ubiquity
items.description: Advancements in smartphone technology have made GoPro cameras irrelevant to “anyone beyond hardcore sports enthusiasts or professional creators,” one analyst says.

items.title: Broadcom’s stock falls despite upbeat earnings, extending a frustrating stretch for investors
items.description: Broadcom shares have gained just 6% so far this year, lagging behind the broader chip sector, which has risen 60%. The company’s outlook offered minimal upside relative to expectations..

items.title: HPE follows in Dell’s footsteps as it rides the AI server boom to a big earnings beat
items.description: Unlike Dell, HPE focuses on enterprise and sovereign customers, which one analyst noted have a better profit profile.

items.title: Snowflake’s stock soars as the company blows away estimates with its AI-fueled forecast
items.description: Companies looking to build AI tools on top of their data are turning to Snowflake, driving robust revenue growth.

items.title: SpaceX’s big AI advantage is why this analyst thinks the stock could double
items.description: The company is adding computing infrastructure quickly, an Oppenheimer analyst notes. SpaceX is also getting large technology players to pay handsomely for its computing power.
